sentences.text: Researchers created a new online database called M2iOR to collect and standardize data on how insect smell receptors interact with odor molecules.

This resource currently holds information from 35,891 experiments covering 30,348 specific pairs of insect receptors and molecules, gathered from 41 published sources, and stores detailed information including chemical structures, receptor DNA sequences, the insect species involved, mixture details, and full experimental notes.

Users can search the database to find which molecules activate or fail to activate specific insect smell receptors, and the tool allows researchers to download simplified data formats that represent smell coding patterns for use in further computer-based analysis.
